reviews.content:
I wanted Windows to follow a light theme during the day and a dark one at night without toggling it by hand, and this mod does that. You set a schedule and it switches the appearance for you. It can also swap wallpapers and full themes, not just the light/dark setting, so the desktop stays consistent.

What I liked:

Schedule-based switching. Set it once and forget it.
Hotkey support. If you want to switch manually, say for a bright room at night, one key press does it.
Custom script support. This is handy if you want to trigger other things when the theme changes.
Runs through Windhawk. It installs in a couple of clicks, and you can disable or remove it without leaving anything behind.
